data: At the end of fiscal 2024, Amazon held $78,779 million in cash and cash equivalents (balance sheet dated December 31, 2024), while Apple held $29,943 million (balance sheet dated September 28, 2024). Amazon's figure is therefore about 2.63 times Apple's, a gap of roughly $48.8 billion. These are the balance sheet cash and cash equivalents lines, which exclude marketable securities and restricted cash. Amazon's cash-flow statement shows a larger total of $82,312 million because it includes restricted cash. The two companies also have different fiscal year-ends, so the balances are not measured on the same date.
